Definition: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
BiblicalUsage: To do, or to work, is the word for making and acting. Moses sang of the sanctuary which God's hands have established, and warned Israel lest their enemies say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe doing is the word for God's work and mine: His hands established the sanctuary, and my hands are to do what He commands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
